scope: Python Decimal and native binding performance repair

references.application: Reuse cached Decimal type and exact coefficient/scale conversion; remove duplicate parsing in Alopex native execution. Exact built-in Decimal uses bounded canonical-text parsing; subclass hooks retain legacy path.
references.intentional_difference: Alopex rejects non-finite values and precision/scale outside 38; DuckDB may fall back to floating point. No float fallback added.
references.license: MIT; consulted implementation, no source or test fixture copied.
references.test_classification: handwritten-regression; oracle executes Python Decimal tuple and fixed-point formatting, not DuckDB conformance

verification.correctness: Focused PR checkout based on 5847a511: release extension built successfully; 212 Python SQL/remote tests passed; 4 Rust Decimal tests passed including the independent tuple/format property oracle; fmt, Ruff and all-targets/all-features alopex-py Clippy passed. Benchmark script completed 42000 checked calls as a smoke test; that concurrent-build timing is excluded from performance evidence.
verification.mutation: 6 selected Decimal parser mutants caught; no survivors in selected set.
verification.benchmark: 6 fresh processes per arm, 21 measured samples x 1000 checked SQL calls per process, same Python and release profile. Composed candidate before 12.2696255 ms/1000 Decimal calls; repaired 8.215 ms (-33.05%). Integer 10.4202915 -> 6.7164995 ms (-35.54%). This run excludes the rejected FIFO experiment.
verification.benchmark_scope: macOS arm64, in-memory SELECT ? AS value round trip; not a released-package or cross-platform qualification.
verification.coupling: Existing database/transaction cycle and shared binding converter retained. Converter impacts native execution, transaction and remote rendering; Python regression suite covers these paths. Static timing, identity, implicit functional and macro/cfg blind spots remain; no new cross-crate dependency.
verification.measured_source: 02d30d1e20fb914149245f3e23018d6e56f009fa plus this Python patch and early stale-commit check; the in-memory SQL workload does not use the disk commit path. The focused PR targets the Decimal parent branch rather than the full composed candidate.
verification.reproduce: Build both arms using the same release profile and PYO3_PYTHON. Alternate six fresh processes per arm with PYTHONPATH=<package-parent> python crates/alopex-py/tests/benchmarks/bench_native_parameters.py; compare the median of process medians. Run without concurrent builds.

review_followup.defects: Six-surface boundary review reproduced seven failing cases: mixed Decimal/datetime bindings returned float, while SQL streams rejected valid integer trailing zeros through typed-literal precision inference. Preserve Decimal type/scale in the shared embedded renderer using an explicit exact CAST; streaming and remote rendering reuse it.
review_followup.regressions: Tuple-oracle grid and subclass formatting checks now cover database native/mixed/stream, transaction native/stream and prepared APIs; embedded fallback/native comparison checks variant, coefficient and scale, precision 38/scale 38 and invalid values.
review_followup.verification: 227 Python SQL/remote tests passed with rebuilt development extension; 24 prepared-statement tests passed, one designated performance test ignored; four Rust Decimal tests passed; six selected shared-renderer mutants caught, no survivors; post-restoration prepared-statement tests passed. fmt, Ruff for both changed Python files and all-target/all-feature embedded/Python Clippy passed before push.
review_followup.coupling: Scoped embedded and Python source analyses with --changed-since main --impact-depth 4. Accepted existing shared formatter dependency; inspected prepared -> lib -> SQL session/owned SQL and Python converter -> database/transaction/stream/remote paths. Existing database/transaction cycles and converter hotspot retained. Static analysis cannot cover runtime timing/identity, implicit semantic duplication or macro/cfg edges; executed public API regressions cover the affected paths.
review_followup.benchmark_scope: Earlier -33.05%/-35.54% measurements remain tied to their recorded source. The separate follow-up recheck above measures this reviewed release source against submitted PR657, not against the original pre-optimization candidate.
review_followup.parser_scope: Typed-literal trailing-zero inference is independently fixed on fix/v0816-decimal-literal-precision. This Python/embedded fix uses explicit CAST and is verified against the unchanged parser, so it does not require that parser fix to preserve parameter types.
review_followup.release_verification: Rebuilt release extension: all 97 SQL tests passed. Post-lint remote suite: 130 passed on the development extension.

performance_recheck.design: Submitted PR657 release binary 8f53bcb0 versus this reviewed source, identical release profile and Python; six fresh processes per arm in alternating order, 21 recorded samples x 1000 checked calls per case/process, no concurrent owned build.
performance_recheck.interpretation: No regression observed in the tested native SELECT workload; sub-1% differences are not claimed as a speedup. Does not qualify other platforms or mixed/stream throughput.
